title: Composition coherence of the specified coefficient pullback comparisons
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a field k of prime characteristic different from ℓ, a finite coefficient field E inside PadicAlgCl ℓ, and separated schemes X,Y,X′,Y′ of finite type over k. Let f:X→Y, g:Y′→Y, f′:X′→Y′ and g′:X′→X be k-morphisms with g′≫f=f′≫g. Use the bounded constructible categories, pullbacks and square comparison θ_A of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], and scalar extension T and the specified pullback comparisons α_h of [def-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-comparisons]. For each V in C_E(Y), α_f′(Lg_E V)⁻¹, followed by T_X′(θ_E(V)) and α_g′(Lf_E V), equals Lf′_Ω(α_g(V)), followed by θ_Ω(T_Y V) and Lg′_Ω(α_f(V)⁻¹). Here both paths start at Lf′_Ω(T_Y′(Lg_E V)) and end at Lg′_Ω(T_X(Lf_E V)). No properness, Cartesianity, push comparison or exchange morphism is assumed.

proof.text: Specialize the proved generic derived_pull_comp calculation in ContinuousIntegralPullComposition to the flat condensed ring map E → PadicAlgCl ℓ. Apply Iso.ext and ObjectProperty.hom_ext, reduce restricted functor projections, and use the existing bounded_comp_hom equation for both coefficient rings. Evaluate derived_pull_comp at K.obj, simplify the identity associators, and normalize the scalar-functor and over-category projections. This proves qbarPullIso_comp with no new statement or hypothesis.

The pull comparison respects equality of geometric morphisms: substitute the equality, after which both transports are reflexive isomorphisms and the functorial unit identities close the equation. This is qbarPull_eq.

Apply qbarPullIso_comp to (g′,f) and (f′,g), and qbarPull_eq to sq.w.symm. The existing proved private mapped_iso_rectangle calculation, reused through import all of ContinuousIntegralExchangeTargetAdjunct, pastes these three equalities. Instantiate the existing boundedConstructiblePullbackSquareComparison_app API at E and Ω. Apply congrArg to these component equations under the two paths of the square, and compose the resulting equalities with the pasted rectangle equation. Using these explicit equalities avoids unfolding the full derived square construction during kernel comparison. This proves qbarPull_square_cube_iso.

The elementary generic coefficientCube_of_iso lemma takes hom components of the pasted isomorphism equality and cancels the invertible α_f′ on the left and the image of α_f on the right using the existing proved private inverse_mapped_square from ContinuousIntegralExchangeTargetAdjunct. Its conclusion is the generic coefficientPullbackCube predicate, preserving that abstraction during the concrete specialization. Apply it to qbarPull_square_cube_iso to prove the original public statement without unfolding concrete category instances. The original hom-component helper qbarPull_square_cube is also proved. No exchange morphism, push comparison, properness or Cartesianity is used.
